front.title: Cryptographic Algorithms That Produce 256-bit MACs For Use With TCP-AO

abstract.t:
RFC5926 creates a list of cryptographic algorithms that can be used with TCP-AO. This document expands that list, adding two Message Authentication Code (MAC) algorithms, HMAC-SHA256 and KMAC256. For each MAC algorithm, a corresponding Key Derivation Function (KDF) is also added.
The MAC algorithms described by this document produce 256-bit (i.e., 32-byte) MACs. When 32-byte MACs are encoded in TCP-AO, the TCP-AO consumes 36 of the 40 bytes available for TCP options.
